title: Salah
intro: Salah is the second pillar of Islam – given to us by Allah in the heavens.

learn.html: Salah is the second main duty of a Muslim – the second pillar of Islam. It was commanded right after the Shahadah, directly by Allah, in the heavens – unlike the other duties, which were commanded on earth. Because it is so important, Allah mentions Salah in more than 100 places in the Qur’an, and it is the first thing we will be asked about on the Day of Judgement.

Salah is the best way to show obedience and thanks to Allah. All of Allah’s messengers and their peoples prayed. Not only people on earth – the angels and jinn also show obedience to Allah through prayer.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) said: “And know that your best deed is the prayer.” (Ahmad)

items: Allah cleans us from our sins and promises help and reward
in Salah we are closest to our Lord, so we ask Him for help
we learn to be thankful and on time
it is good for the body – exercise and cleanliness

options.text: ⏰ We learn to be on time

options.why: Salah is worship – we stand before Allah.

questions.q: Which pillar of Islam is Salah?
How many times is Salah mentioned in the Qur’an?
What did the Prophet (SAW) say is our best deed?

practice.title: Questions to talk about
prompts: 💬 Which is the second pillar of Islam? When and where was Salah commanded?
💬 Why is Salah important? What does it give us?
